name: campaign-utility-tool
narrative: Amara opens her campaign and the whole picture is already here — funding, enrolment, attendance, verification and payment status, in one read. She moves to release pay, and the tool blocks a worker whose ID check was rejected — the bad payment never leaves. And it's the whole nation: five thousand workers across all 37 states, paged through without a stutter. His KYC shows why — a duplicate national-ID flag — so she holds him instead of paying. Before releasing more funds she checks the microplans: planned budget and workforce against what's actually been spent. The worker she's been acting on is a real CommCare case on a real ward — name, role, NIN, location. Not a mock. In System Administration the audit log holds every payment hold and decision she just made, against her name. She ends on the reporting board — per-state coverage across all 37 states — and exports the week's numbers for the donor. And the coverage map: every state shaded by reach, every worker's location on top — where the country still needs her.

amara.intro: Amara manages Nigeria's national measles–rubella vaccination campaign and needs to see its real-time state and act on payments, verification, planning and coverage from one place.
amara.name: Amara

features.description: Overview renders server-side KPIs (funding, progress, workforce, KYC/payment donuts) over all workers
features.verify: Playwright: load /campaign/?campaign=MR-NAT-2026; assert the Overview KPI cards and the KYC/payment donuts render with non-zero values.

scenes.narrative: Amara opens her campaign and the whole picture is already here — funding, enrolment, attendance, verification and payment status, in one read.
scenes.title: The campaign at a glance

features.description: Payment approval is refused for workers with rejected KYC or fraud flags (server-enforced)
features.verify: Playwright: in Workers -> Payments, a worker with rejected KYC shows a non-approvable/Rejected payment status.

scenes.narrative: She moves to release pay, and the tool blocks a worker whose ID check was rejected — the bad payment never leaves.
scenes.title: The tool stops an ineligible payment

features.description: The worker roster is paginated server-side so a national-scale campaign stays usable
features.verify: Playwright: in Workers -> Worker Payments, assert a national worker count, a 37-state filter, and pagination controls are shown.

scenes.narrative: And it's the whole nation: five thousand workers across all 37 states, paged through without a stutter.
scenes.title: The whole country, and it stays fast

features.description: KYC view surfaces status, documents, and shared-identifier duplicate detection
features.verify: Playwright: in Workers -> Worker KYC, assert verification status, documents, and duplicate/shared-identifier flags are shown.

scenes.narrative: His KYC shows why — a duplicate national-ID flag — so she holds him instead of paying.
scenes.title: Verification, with the fraud signal attached

features.description: Per-area microplans track planned vs actual workforce, budget vs spent, doses and coverage targets
features.verify: Playwright: in Activity -> Microplanning & Budget, assert a per-area row shows planned vs actual workforce and budget vs spent.

scenes.narrative: Before releasing more funds she checks the microplans: planned budget and workforce against what's actually been spent.
scenes.title: Planned versus actual, per area

features.description: Workers are CommCare cases on real AdminBoundary geography, read through the Case API
features.verify: Playwright: in Workers -> Worker Profiles, assert CommCare-case fields (name, role, NIN) and a real ward/LGA/state placement are shown.

scenes.narrative: The worker she's been acting on is a real CommCare case on a real ward — name, role, NIN, location. Not a mock.
scenes.title: A worker is a real CommCare case

features.description: Privileged actions are recorded to an audit log; access is role-controlled (RBAC)
features.verify: Playwright: in System Administration -> User Management, assert the audit log lists actions with actor, action, module and timestamp.

scenes.narrative: In System Administration the audit log holds every payment hold and decision she just made, against her name.
scenes.title: Every decision, on the record

features.description: Reporting produces real CSV exports and a custom-report builder
features.verify: Playwright: in Reporting click 'Export data'; assert a CSV download is triggered.

scenes.narrative: She ends on the reporting board — per-state coverage across all 37 states — and exports the week's numbers for the donor.
scenes.title: The donor's numbers, exported

features.description: Coverage map renders a Nigeria choropleth (shaded by worker count) plus worker GPS points
features.verify: Playwright: in Reporting click 'View map'; assert a Mapbox canvas paints with shaded states and worker points.

scenes.narrative: And the coverage map: every state shaded by reach, every worker's location on top — where the country still needs her.
scenes.title: Coverage, read off the map
